requirement_vague: Password reset should reject new_password with 7 characters with a 422 validation error.

omissions.description: There is no POST /api/v1/reset-password/ endpoint in the code. The password reset endpoint is entirely missing.
omissions.reasoning: Searching the entire codebase, there is no route defined for /reset-password/ or any password reset functionality. The only password-related endpoints are /login/access-token and /users/me/password (PATCH). Therefore, the requirement to validate new_password length at POST /api/v1/reset-password/ cannot be satisfied.
